description: This file contains the implementation of the MediaPipelineTestBase class, which provides setup, teardown, and utility methods for testing media pipeline components. It includes mock object management, creation and destruction of media pipeline instances, and state notification methods.

classes.name: MediaPipelineTestBase
classes.description: A base class for media pipeline unit tests, providing common setup, teardown, and utility functions.

methods.name: TearDown
methods.description: Cleans up mock objects after tests.

methods.name: createMediaPipeline
methods.description: Creates and initializes a media pipeline instance with mock dependencies.

methods.name: destroyMediaPipeline
methods.description: Destroys the media pipeline instance and resets related callbacks.

methods.name: setPlaybackState
methods.description: Simulates a change in playback state for testing.

methods.name: setNetworkState
methods.description: Simulates a change in network state for testing.

methods.name: needData
methods.description: Simulates a media data request for testing.
